rationale_overall: The 15-name watchlist already spans every wave in the profile with reasonable depth: AI (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA, AMD), general market (SPY), rockets/spacecraft (RKLB), geopolitical/defense (ITA, LMT, GD), nuclear (SMR), quantum (IONQ), robotics/automation (ROK, ISRG), and commodities/tanker (FRO). Pass-1 discovery across every named wave surfaced only thin, mostly micro-cap or unlisted-history candidates within the Jul-Sep 2023 window (Planet Labs, AST SpaceMobile, Intuitive Machines, Rigetti, Symbotic, Cameco, Welltower) -- none carried a clean, dated, in-window catalyst strong enough to clear the add bar once post-date releases (Welltower Q3, ISRG Q3, the Israel-Hamas-war defense rally) were correctly excluded as dated after 2023-09-30. On current holdings, Pass-2 found continued buildup-phase strength and one caution flag -- Rocket Lab's Sept 19 Electron anomaly -- that does not rise to a fundamental thesis breach (single failure, prior recovery precedent, and RKLB is the watchlist's only rockets/spacecraft exposure). Net effect: hold the watchlist unchanged this quarter.
